settings.text:
Discover your style — the circular way.

Through our Style Me Sustainably initiative, you can connect with one of our trusted partnered stylists to curate looks you’ll love using beautifully made, high-end preloved pieces from My Circular Wardrobe.

Whether you’re refreshing your wardrobe, building timeless essentials, or looking for something special, our stylists will help you shop more consciously without compromising on style.

settings.title: Louise Lawton
settings.text:
Bristol, UK

Louise is a CPD-accredited personal stylist passionate about helping others feel proud, confident and content in how they look. She believes that 'self care is not selfish care' and understands the challenges of balancing busy life as a working woman and mum. By helping clients identify their best colours and signature style, Louise makes getting dressed simpler and more enjoyable, enabling them to feel authentically themselves every day.

settings.title: Sian Clarke
settings.text:
London, UK

Sian Clarke is a Personal Stylist, brand ambassador, and Colour Lecturer at The London College of Style, specialising in Colour Analysis and confidence transformation. With celebrity clients and features across major media, Sian’s empowering, collaborative approach helps clients rediscover their confidence, understand colour and body shape, and express their individuality through style. Sian believes style “rules” are meant to be broken — she listens deeply, advises expertly, and encourages individuality, helping clients use clothing as a powerful expression of who they truly are.

settings.title: Keren Beaumont
settings.text:
London, UK

Keren believes in the power of style to transform how we feel and show up in the world. Having experienced wardrobe disconnects herself, she understands the confidence that comes from dressing authentically. Her philosophy centres on effortless, genuine style that reflects who you truly are. With 15 years in buying at Ralph Lauren and Coach, she brings deep industry insight to her work. Keren promotes mindful consumption — buying less and choosing well. Above all, Keren aims to help each client feel seen, confident and effortlessly themselves.

settings.title: Cynthia Liza
settings.text:
London, UK

With over a decade of experience styling both men and women around the world, Cynthia helps clients uncover their authentic style through a conscious, lasting approach to fashion. Inspired by her father’s passion for restoring antique cars, she learned early the value of craftsmanship, care, and giving beautiful items a second life. At Conscious Closets by Cynthia, sustainability is woven into every step - from thoughtful shopping and wardrobe curation to recycling, reselling, and reimagining what you already own. Her goal is to help you build a wardrobe that feels personal, intentional, and enduring - one that supports both your lifestyle and the planet.

settings.title: Lucy Briggs-Sustainably Styled
settings.text:
Oxfordshire, UK

Lucy is an award-winning, sustainable personal stylist who works with women with low body confidence who feel no joy in dressing to find their style again. A lover of charity shops and vintage, she helps them to curate a wardrobe that makes them feel amazing and doesn't cost our Earth. She helps her clients to make the shift from dopamine shopping to enjoying the serotonin happiness of a wardrobe that's uniquely them.

settings.title: Emma Shoe-Stying you Well
settings.text:
UK
 
Emma Shoe is the go-to Personal Stylist for purpose driven mid life women who want to dress in colourful, consciously put together looks. Emma’s expertise is helping her clients to create colourful more sustainable wardrobes and source outfits for key events using pieces RESTYLED from existing wardrobe items,
PRE-LOVED, RESPONSIBLY sourced + RENTAL.

settings.title: Felicity Day
settings.text:
Southampton, UK
 
Felicity Day is a professional stylist dedicated to helping women and men of all ages feel confident in their personal style. She specialises in creating wardrobes that are not only functional and effortless, but also thoughtfully sustainable. With a warm, considered approach, Felicity guides clients to pieces that reflect who they are and supports them in building a wardrobe they can genuinely enjoy wearing.
If you’re a stylist and would like to be part of our Style Me Sustainably programme, we’d love to hear from you — please get in touch.
